name: ateam-uae-health-compliance
description: Checks a healthcare software system against UAE healthcare regulations (federal ICT Health Law and data localisation, MOHAP Riayati, DoH Abu Dhabi ADHICS v2, Malaffi and Responsible AI, DHA Dubai NABIDH, consent, AI and telehealth standards) and produces a sourced engineering checklist as a tracked register and an Excel file, then re-checks as engineers close the gaps.
